fullText.simplified:
二十、蛇妖

    和尚来到许仙家，他要用钵盂收白素贞和小青。
    “大师，虽然我们是妖，但我们并没有害人。你为什么要收我们？”白素贞问。
    和尚说：“几年前的那一次我就该收了你，让你跑了，我还找了你很多天呢。现在你说你没有害人，那为什么要和人结婚？”
    “为什么不可以？我和许仙是真心相爱的，我们一起过上了幸福的生活，这有什么错？”
    “你是妖！妖这种坏东西，怎么能和人在一起呢？”
    小青大声说：“姐姐，和这老和尚没什么好说的，动手吧！”
    和尚大笑：“很好，来吧！”
    青光和金光在空中相遇，天空被照亮，地面和房子都在动。小青“啊”地大叫了一声。
    “小心！小青！”白素贞变成白光，飞向了空中。
    三道光在空中打来打去，杭州城的天被照亮了。城里的人都醒了，许仙也被惊醒了。他爬下床，跑到外面，见到空中两条又粗又大的蛇正和一件袈裟打来打去。
    那两条蛇一条青色，一条白色，许仙的脸都吓白了，“这……白蛇……是真的！我见过这条白蛇！”
    城里的人都看到了，都大叫起来：“天啊！有妖怪啊！是蛇妖！”
    许仙马上跑回房间，大叫：“夫人！夫人！你在哪儿！快出来，快来看！真的有白蛇！”他叫了半天，却没有见到白素贞，他再叫：“小青！小青！”也没有人回答他。
    他把每个房间都找完了，还是没有看到白素贞和小青。他担心极了，“夫人和小青去哪儿了？是不是被蛇妖吃了？啊！怎么办？”他冲出房间，跑到街上，对着天上打得正厉害的白蛇和青蛇叫道：“妖怪！我的夫人在哪里？是不是在你们那儿！快把她还回来！”
    空中的白素贞听到了，心中一惊，忍不住难过起来。和尚的金光向她劈来，她没有躲开，被重重地劈到了地上。
    “姐姐！”小青惊叫着飞下来，变成人形，落在白蛇身边。
    许仙吓得眼睛都直了，“小青？你……你……”
    小青却没有看他，只担心地抱着白蛇，问：“姐姐，你怎么样？”
    “姐姐？小青……你……你在叫谁姐姐？”许仙都不会说话了。
    白蛇慢慢变成人形，但她一点儿力气都没有了，脸色发白。
    小青生气地看向空中的袈裟：“老和尚，你敢打我姐姐，我杀了你！”
    袈裟落在了地上，和尚从袈裟后面走出来。他抬起钵盂，对着白素贞，叫道：“收！”
    金光照向白素贞，白素贞疼得大叫。
fullText.traditional:
二十、蛇妖

    和尚來到許仙家，他要用缽盂收白素貞和小青。
    “大師，雖然我們是妖，但我們並沒有害人。你為什麼要收我們？”白素貞問。
    和尚說：“幾年前的那一次我就該收了你，讓你跑了，我還找了你很多天呢。現在你說你沒有害人，那為什麼要和人結婚？”
    “為什麼不可以？我和許仙是真心相愛的，我們一起過上了幸福的生活，這有什麼錯？”
    “你是妖！妖這種壞東西，怎麼能和人在一起呢？”
    小青大聲說：“姐姐，和這老和尚沒什麼好說的，動手吧！”
    和尚大笑：“很好，來吧！”
    青光和金光在空中相遇，天空被照亮，地面和房子都在動。小青“啊”地大叫了一聲。
    “小心！小青！”白素貞變成白光，飛向了空中。
    三道光在空中打來打去，杭州城的天被照亮了。城裡的人都醒了，許仙也被驚醒了。他爬下床，跑到外面，見到空中兩條又粗又大的蛇正和一件袈裟打來打去。
    那兩條蛇一條青色，一條白色，許仙的臉都嚇白了，“這……白蛇……是真的！我見過這條白蛇！”
    城裡的人都看到了，都大叫起來：“天啊！有妖怪啊！是蛇妖！”
    許仙馬上跑回房間，大叫：“夫人！夫人！你在哪兒！快出來，快來看！真的有白蛇！”他叫了半天，卻沒有見到白素貞，他再叫：“小青！小青！”也沒有人回答他。
    他把每個房間都找完了，還是沒有看到白素貞和小青。他擔心極了，“夫人和小青去哪兒了？是不是被蛇妖吃了？啊！怎麼辦？”他衝出房間，跑到街上，對著天上打得正厲害的白蛇和青蛇叫道：“妖怪！我的夫人在哪裡？是不是在你們那兒！快把她還回來！”
    空中的白素貞聽到了，心中一驚，忍不住難過起來。和尚的金光向她劈來，她沒有躲開，被重重地劈到了地上。
    “姐姐！”小青驚叫著飛下來，變成人形，落在白蛇身邊。
    許仙嚇得眼睛都直了，“小青？你……你……”
    小青卻沒有看他，只擔心地抱著白蛇，問：“姐姐，你怎麼樣？”
    “姐姐？小青……你……你在叫誰姐姐？”許仙都不會說話了。
    白蛇慢慢變成人形，但她一點兒力氣都沒有了，臉色發白。
    小青生氣地看向空中的袈裟：“老和尚，你敢打我姐姐，我殺了你！”
    袈裟落在了地上，和尚從袈裟後面走出來。他抬起缽盂，對著白素貞，叫道：“收！”
    金光照向白素貞，白素貞疼得大叫。

sentences.simplified: 白蛇慢慢变成人形，但她一点儿力气都没有了，脸色发白。
sentences.traditional: 白蛇慢慢變成人形，但她一點兒力氣都沒有了，臉色發白。
sentences.pinyin: bái shé màn man biàn chéng rén xíng dàn tā yì diǎn'r lì qi dōu méi yǒu le liǎn sè fā bái
sentences.english: The white snake slowly transformed into human form, but she had no strength left, and her face was pale.

sentences.simplified: 小青生气地看向空中的袈裟：“老和尚，你敢打我姐姐，我杀了你！”
sentences.traditional: 小青生氣地看向空中的袈裟：“老和尚，你敢打我姐姐，我殺了你！”
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo qīng shēng qì de kàn xiàng kōng zhōng de jiā shā lǎo hé shang nǐ gǎn dǎ wǒ jiě jie wǒ shā le nǐ
sentences.english: Xiaoqing angrily looked at the robe in the air: “Old monk, you dare attack my older sister, I’ll kill you!”

sentences.simplified: 袈裟落在了地上，和尚从袈裟后面走出来。
sentences.traditional: 袈裟落在了地上，和尚從袈裟後面走出來。
sentences.pinyin: jiā shā luò zài le dì shang hé shang cóng jiā shā hòu miàn zǒu chu lai
sentences.english: The robe landed on the ground, and the monk walked out from behind the robe.

sentences.simplified: 他抬起钵盂，对着白素贞，叫道：“收！”
sentences.traditional: 他抬起缽盂，對著白素貞，叫道：“收！”

sentences.english: He raised his alms bowl, faced Bai Suzhen, and shouted, “Detain!”

sentence_translations: 20. Snake Demons
The monk came to Xu Xian’s house. He wanted to use his alms bowl to detain Bai Suzhen and Xiaoqing.
“Master, although we are demons, we have not harmed anyone. Why do you want to detain us?” Bai Suzhen asked.
The monk said, “I should have detained you that time several years ago.
But I let you get away, and I searched for you for many days.
Now you say you haven’t harmed anyone. So why did you marry a human?”
“Why not? Xu Xian and I are truly in love, and we are living a happy life together. What’s wrong with that?”
“You are a demon! How could such a horrible thing like a demon be together with a human?”
Xiaoqing shouted loudly, “Older Sister, there’s nothing to say to this old monk. Bring it on!”
The monk laughed loudly, “Very good, come at me!”
The green light and golden light met midair, illuminating the sky, while the ground and houses trembled.
Xiaoqing let out a loud “Ah!”
“Be careful! Xiaoqing!” Bai Suzhen transformed into white light and flew into the air.
The three beams of light clashed in the air, illuminating the sky over Hangzhou.
The people in the city were all woken up, and Xu Xian was also startled awake.
He got out of bed and ran outside, where he saw two thick, large snakes battling with a robe in the air.
The two snakes, one green and one white, scared Xu Xian so much that his face turned pale.
“This … white snake … is real! I have seen this white snake before!”
All of the people in the city saw this and shouted, “Oh my goodness! There are demons! Snake demons!”
Xu Xian immediately ran back to the room, shouting, “My wife! My wife! Where are you?
Come out quickly, come and see! There really is a white snake!”
He shouted for a long time, but didn’t see Bai Suzhen.
He then shouted, “Xiaoqing! Xiaoqing!” No one answered him either.
He finished searching every room, but still didn’t see Bai Suzhen or Xiaoqing.
He was extremely worried: “Where did my wife and Xiaoqing go? Did they get eaten by the snake demons? Ah! What should I do?”
He rushed out of the room and ran out into the street.
He shouted at the white snake and green snake fighting fiercely in the sky:
“Demons! Where is my wife? Is she with you? Quick, bring her back!”
Bai Suzhen, who was midair, heard this. She felt a shock in her heart, and couldn’t help but feel sad.
The monk’s golden light struck towards her. She didn’t dodge it and fell heavily to the ground.
“Older Sister!” Xiaoqing screamed as she flew down.
She transformed into human form and landed beside the white snake.
Xu Xian’s eyes went wide with fear: “Xiaoqing? You .. you …”
However, Xiaoqing didn’t look at him. Instead, she anxiously held the white snake and asked, “Older Sister, are you okay?”
“Older Sister? Xiaoqing … You … who are you calling Older Sister?” Xu Xian was at a loss for words.
The white snake slowly transformed into human form, but she had no strength left, and her face was pale.
Xiaoqing angrily looked at the robe in the air: “Old monk, you dare attack my older sister, I’ll kill you!”
The robe landed on the ground, and the monk walked out from behind the robe.
He raised his alms bowl, faced Bai Suzhen, and shouted, “Detain!”
The golden light shone on Bai Suzhen, and Bai Suzhen cried out in pain.
